facts.business: The company was formerly known as Jetmall Spices and Masala Limited and has been renamed to Artemis ADR Marketplace Limited, indicating a shift from spices and masala business to an ADR marketplace model.
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions were made with Promoters, Directors, KMPs or other designated persons that may have a potential conflict with the interest of the Company. Details are provided in Form AOC-2 (Annexure D).
